sourceMethod: git archive exact immutable Pro commit into a separate temporary directory before editing integration source
notes: The optional-font fixture initially failed 1/443; unmodified baseline passed with the documented local font path supplied. This server defect is separately repaired in the integration candidate.
The direct TAP counts come from actual subprocess execution. Sandbox-blocked EPERM attempts were rejected as evidence.
The browser profile and host data were isolated and synthetic. There was no live ChatGPT, personal Mac, cloud model, or actual PAIA acceptance.
Performance uses original development targets and raw 30-sample Node/MockIDB measurements; it is not real browser disk or real-host performance.
This is incoming source evidence, not evidence for a later integration commit.
